title: Table 18. PWR features
text_helper: Table 18. PWR features — section 6.2.5 Power (PWR). PWR, STM32H5, STM32C5.

rows: VDD = 1.71 V to 3.6 V: external power supply for the I/Os, the internal regulator, and the system analogs such as reset, power management, and internal clocks. It is provided externally through the VDD pins.
VDD = 2.7 to 3.6 V: external power supply for I/Os and the internal regulator (when enabled), provided externally through VDD pins.
VDDA = 1.62 V ADCs/1.8 V (DAC), 2.1 V (VREFBUF) to 3.6 V: external analog power supply for ADC, DAC, and voltage reference buffer. The VDDA voltage level is independent from the VDD voltage.
VDDA: external analog power supplies for ADC, DAC, reset blocks, RCs. This product has no separeted VDDA pad. VDDA is internally connected to VDD.
VCAP = 1.0 V to 1.35 V: power supply for digital peripherals, SRAMs (except BKPSRAM), and embedded flash memory
VCAP = 0.95 V to 1.25 V: power supply for digital peripherals, SRAMs and embedded flash memory
VBAT = 1.2 V to 3.6 V: when VDD is not present, VBAT is the power supply for RTC, the external clock 32 kHz oscillator, backup registers, and optional backup SRAM
VDDUSB = 3.0 V to 3.6 V: external independent power supply for USB transceivers. The VDDUSB voltage level is independent from the VDD voltage.
Supply for USB transceivers. This product has no separeted VDDUSB pad. VDDUSB is internally connected to VDD
VDDIO2 = 1.08 V to 3.6 V: external power supply for 10 I/Os (PD6, PD7, PG9:14, PB8, PB9). This voltage is independent from the VDD voltage.
Battery backup domain or RTC domain
RTC with backup registers (128 bytes) LSE LSE, backup SRAM when the low-power backup regulator is enabled PC13 to PC15 I/Os
RTC with backup registers LSE PC13 to PC15 I/Os
AVD, BOR Backup domain voltage and temperature monitoring
WKUPx pin edge, RTC event, external reset in NRST pin, IWDG reset, BOR reset
WKUP pin edge RTC alarm (alarm A and alarm B), RTC wake-up, tamper event, time stamp event, external reset in NRST pin IWDG reset External reset in NRST pin

Any EXTI line (configured in the EXTI registers, internal and external lines)
